responsibilities: SQL & Performance Tuning: Design, optimize, and maintain complex SQL/T-SQL solutions. Analyze execution plans, implement indexing strategies, and resolve bottlenecks in large volumes of data.
ETL & Data Warehouse: Develop and manage robust ETL processes in Enterprise Data Warehouse (DWH) environments.
Data Modeling & Cubes: Build and evolve star schemas, fact/dimension tables, advanced analytical models, and OLAP cubes.
Power BI & Business Logic: Translate complex business models and logic into efficient BI solutions using advanced DAX in Power BI.
Collaboration & Scalability: Work side by side with BI, Data Engineering teams, and stakeholders to deliver scalable and reliable solutions.
Best Practices: Apply version control (Git) and actively participate in technical discussions regarding architecture and optimization.
